events.evt: [ASCO GI] Phase 2 updated; N=24 (22 evaluable); ORR 37.5% (9 PR), 2L 63.6%, 3L 15.4%; mDoR/mPFS 9.4mo; 12mo OS 53%; grade 3+ TRAE 75%
[AACR] Preclinical updated: CTX-471 eliminated MHC-I-negative tumors in vivo and expanded NK/CD8 immune activity; no patient data
[ASCO] Phase 1 updated; N=79 (19 escalation/60 expansion); CR 1/3 SCLC; PR 3/11 melanoma and 1/4 mesothelioma; DLT thrombocytopenia resolved; liver toxicity 6.3%, 80% AEs grade 1-2
events.safety: resolved thrombocytopenia DLT; liver toxicity 6.3%; 80% AEs grade 1-2

events.evt: [SITC] Phase 1 updated biomarker: baseline NCAM/CD56 tumor expression associated with CTX-471 response/disease control; prior efficacy CR 1 SCLC plus 4 PR; generally well tolerated
[CALL] Phase 2/3 primary; N=168 (111/57); BICR ORR 17.1% vs 5.3%, p=0.031; CR 1 vs 0; PD 16.2% vs 42.1%; safety DMC continued study unchanged
[AACR] Preclinical updated: CTX-471 plus tovecimig enhanced efficacy in checkpoint-refractory models with increased tumor killing, antigen presentation and interferon signaling; no patient data
[SITC] Preclinical updated: CTX-10726 PD-1×VEGF-A bispecific showed differentiated dual-pathway activity and supported Phase 1 advancement; no patient data

[CALL] Phase 2/3 updated secondary; N=168 (111/57); ORR 17.1% vs 5.3%; PFS 4.7 vs 2.6mo, HR 0.44, p<0.0001; ITT OS 8.9 vs 9.4mo, HR 1.05; crossover OS 12.8 vs 6.1mo; grade 3+ related HTN 44%, neutropenia 36%
events.survival: PFS 4.7 vs 2.6 months; ITT OS 8.9 vs 9.4 months; crossover OS 12.8 vs 6.1 months

events.survival: TNBC response 10.5+ months; HL response 7.5+ months
